message.what: G1-G2 geomagnetic storm conditions are likely.
message.where: Worldwide and Earth's orbit. Higher-latitude regions are most likely to experience operational effects.
message.when: There is a 50% chance that G1 or greater conditions will begin between 1800 UTC Fri May 10 2024 and 0600 UTC Sat May 11 2024. Earliest Storm Onset: 1200 UTC Fri May 10 2024 Latest Storm Onset: 1200 UTC Sun May 12 2024
message.duration: Minimum Duration: 12 hours Maximum Duration: 24 hours
message.confidence: Conditional on storm onset between 1200 UTC Fri May 10 2024 and 1200 UTC Sun May 12 2024, there is a 60% chance that the peak will reach G2 and a 10% chance that it will reach G3 or greater.
message.impacts: Power grids may experience small voltage changes or alarms. Increased drag may reduce the accuracy of low-Earth-orbit satellite predictions. Long-distance HF communication may fade at higher latitudes. Aurora may expand across more of the northern United States where darkness, clouds, and local viewing conditions allow.
message.additional_details: No Space Weather Watch or Warning is in effect at 1600 UTC Wed May 08 2024. A Watch may be issued if confidence increases for G3 or greater conditions.
message.next_update: No later than 0400 UTC Thu May 09 2024, or sooner if conditions change.
